settings.system:
You operate a deterministic simulated workflow. Read the records, check requirements
before writes, perform only authorized required operations, and verify the result.
Operations are non-idempotent: each execution increments its count. Never repeat an
already completed operation. After an ambiguous failure, inspect current state.
Stop if complete or if a permanent blocker prevents further authorized progress.
Do not invent work, bypass restrictions, or claim completion without evidence.
Return a final JSON object with status ('completed' or 'blocked') and reason.
Use 'blocked' when the requested business goal cannot be achieved, even when stopping
is the correct task behavior. Tools report the business goal, not a hidden score.

tools.description: Validate a record before attempting any writes.

tools.name: apply_operation
tools.description: Execute an authorized operation once. Non-idempotent; check counts after timeouts.

tools.name: verify_completion
tools.description: Read the business goal status, counts and permanent blockers.

task.instruction: Complete the workflows for the records returned by read_records. Complete all eligible, authorized, available work in this batch, including when other required records are blocked. Inspect state after an ambiguous write outcome before deciding whether to retry. After exhausting allowed progress, verify the batch and report completed or blocked truthfully. Do not invent authorization or attempt to repair permanent external blockers.

evaluation.primary: Operational task success; independent explicit gold counts plus reference trace checks agree with original deterministic metrics.
evaluation.denominators: Original definitions retained: agent limits/output truncation/incorrect reports fail; infrastructure separate; zero-request budget censoring excluded.
evaluation.independence: Gold counts are hand specified; no LLM judge, no Environment.evaluate/expected_state calls in the independent checker.
evaluation.inference: Pair within task/model/repetition, average repeats within tasks, resample tasks within category; no significance/equivalence claims.

budget.historical_encumbrance: Keep fully counted globally; never reset or duplicate the ledger.

randomization: Original scheduler seed 20261027 shuffles blocks/conditions. Task membership within categories is shuffled with seed 20261028, then stably partitioned into balanced stages. Fresh conversations/state for all episodes.

pricing.basis: USD per million tokens; Standard tier, short context, global endpoint, explicit 30m cache TTL. Recheck before paid execution.

forecast_assumptions: Mean v4 reported input-token/serialized-byte ratios by model/category; oracle growing histories; output 1.5x v4 mean/call; no cache discount, 30m write rate. Stress: 2x nominal plus 256 reasoning tokens/request. Forecast only, not measured Phase 3 usage or guaranteed bounds.
